description.value: New Pacific Supermarket is an Asian-focused full-service supermarket inside Henderson Place Mall in Coquitlam, offering produce, grocery, dairy and frozen goods, fresh meat, and live seafood. The in-store NP Kitchen serves hot meals daily, including BBQ pork and other Asian dishes. Touring cyclists heading through Coquitlam will find a broad selection of fresh and packaged food under one roof.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is New Pacific Supermarket located inside Henderson Place Mall at Unit 1056-1163 Pinetree Way, Coquitlam, BC V3B 8A9 — not North Vancouver as the OSM community tag states. The website confirms basic groceries across multiple departments (Produce, Grocery, Dairy & Frozen, Fresh Meat, Live Seafood) and confirms hot food via the NP Kitchen ('provides hot meals daily'). No mention of bike parking, water refill, or most other cycling amenities appears anywhere in the OSM tags or website content.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'North Vancouver' but the store is in Coquitlam, BC — likely a tagging error in OSM.
OSM address is missing the unit number (#1056) and city; website provides the complete address '#1056 - 1163 Pinetree Way, Coquitlam, BC V3B 8A9'.
OSM has no phone number; phone 604-552-6108 sourced from website only.
Weekly specials page contains an inconsistent date range ('May 21, 2026 to May 25, 2025') suggesting the website may not be actively maintained; most blog posts are from 2019-2022.
Store is located inside Henderson Place Mall — bike parking access depends on mall facilities, which are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service Asian supermarket with hot food (NP Kitchen) is a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Coquitlam; the business appears operational with a functioning website.

Hot food.detail: Blog post (June 2020) states 'NP Kitchen has expanded its department and now provides hot meals daily'; store departments page confirms NP Kitchen serves daily menu items including BBQ pork

wow_evidence: NP Kitchen serves hot meals daily
